newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns BB-plus to Quezon Power bonds.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BB-plus to Quezon Power bonds.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Monday it has assigned a BB-plus foreign currency rating to Quezon Power (Philippines) Ltd Co's US$203 million senior secured bonds series 1997 due in 2017.
The foreign currency issuer credit rating was BB-plus and the company's foreign currency outlook was positive, it said.
S&P also assigned a BBB-minus local currency issuer credit rating to Quezon Power and said the local currency outlook was stable.
However, the agency noted that Quezon's involvement in a US$781.6 million coal-fired private power project on Luzon island incorporated some risks.

The project required a 36-month construction period in a remote location and Manila Electric Co, a private utility and offtaker under the project's purchase power agreement, might not be able to honour its obligations to the project, it said.
